charges.label: Base freight (per km, by billed weight band)
charges.quote: up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km; 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km; Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.

charges.label: Express service premium (15% of base freight)
charges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

charges.label: Fuel surcharge (12% of freight charge)
charges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

charges.label: Residential delivery accessorial
charges.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

document_rules.rule: Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date; disputed line items are payable only on resolution, undisputed items remain due.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note must reference the original consignment note number and state the invoice it corrects.
Carrier invoices fortnightly; payment is due 30 days from invoice date.

ambiguities.description: The rate card defines weight bands as 'up to and including 500 kg' (rate ₹18/km) and '501 kg to 2,000 kg' (rate ₹24/km). Both bounds are stated in whole kilograms, so a fractional billed weight strictly between 500 kg and 501 kg (e.g. 500.4 kg) falls in neither band and is left undetermined by the contract's own wording.

notes: Weight-based base freight rate applies per km over the whole tier (not per-kg): §1 gives a flat ₹/km rate for each weight band. Express premium (§2) and fuel surcharge (§3) are read in the order the text states them: premium is 15% of base freight only, and fuel surcharge is 12% of (base freight + express premium where applicable), not compounded further. Consignments above 2,000 kg are explicitly outside the rate card (quoted case by case) and are encoded as out_of_card rather than priced. See ambiguities for the fractional-weight gap between the 500kg and 501kg band boundaries as literally written.
